description: Which credential type each identity presents, for the 12 busiest identities. Only Elasticsearch requests record a credential type, so identities seen only in Kibana or only anonymously are not on this chart.

text.expr: length(data('rows')) ? '' : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.authentication.type IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.user.domain, attributes.authentication.type | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | EVAL actor = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NULL AND attributes.user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(actor, " · Cloud API key"), actor), auth = CASE(attributes.authentication.type == "api_key", "API key", attributes.authentication.type == "token", "Token", attributes.authentication.type == "realm", "Realm", attributes.authentication.type == "saml", "SAML", attributes.authentication.type == "anonymous", "Anonymous", attributes.authentication.type == "internal", "Internal", attributes.authentication.type) | STATS events = SUM(events) BY actor, auth | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 2000

values.expr: !length(data('rows')) ? [] : floor(log(domain('opacity')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9) - ceil(log(domain('opacity')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9) >= 1 ? slice([1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000], ceil(log(domain('opacity')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9), 1 + floor(log(domain('opacity')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9)) : domain('opacity')
